svg.title: Dapr round robining a call from one app across three instances of another
svg.desc: On the left, a green hexagon named FrontEnd with an arrow to a hexagon carrying the Dapr logo, named Dapr sidecar. From that sidecar three lines fan out, captioned Round robin load balancing, each turning once and running into its own Dapr sidecar hexagon. Each of those reaches a blue hexagon named Cart. All three are the same application, so all three carry the same name and the same colour, with Instance 1, Instance 2 and Instance 3 written under them in turn.
